title: TTS-backend adapter registry (capability voice-platform)
description: Single index for the /voice pluggable adapter layer (--use=<adapter>). SPLIT registry: a built adapter (status=installed) carries a `generator` script path; a `registered-not-built` stub carries none. Structural shape only; supports[] ⊆ UNIVERSAL_PARAMS, installed⇒generator-on-disk, and preset_of⇒target-exists are enforced by scripts/cross-tier/validate-voice-adapters.cjs.

id.description: Unique adapter slug; the value passed to --use=<id>.

status.description: installed = a real generator wired (file-existence required). registered-not-built = stub: documents intent + native param surface, no generator yet.

generator.description: repo-relative path to the generator script. Required (validator) when status=installed; absent for stubs.

skill.description: repo-relative path to the adapter SKILL.md folder.

preset_of.description: If set, this id is a PRESET alias of another adapter; preset_flags are applied on top.

preset_flags.description: Flags layered on when this preset is used.

voices.description: Count of prebuilt voices the backend exposes (0 for not-built stubs).

supports.description: Universal generation-param flags this adapter honors natively. Must be ⊆ UNIVERSAL_PARAMS (scripts/voice/lib/params.cjs).

unsupported_warn.description: Generation params with no mapping on this backend → WARN (never silent-drop). Must be ⊆ UNIVERSAL_PARAMS.

env.description: env var holding the provider key (null = no key).
